concepts.title: ACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Step-by-step procedure to activate and configure the Aggregated PM Events feature.

concepts.title: DEACTIVATION PROCEDURE
concepts.description: Step-by-step procedure to deactivate the Aggregated PM Events feature and revert the node to raw event emission.

concepts.title: Feature Dependencies
concepts.description: Outlines the feature, hardware, and network dependencies, as well as operational limitations for the Aggregated PM Events feature.

concepts.title: FEATURE OPERATION
concepts.description: Describes the operational flow of the Aggregated PM Events feature, including event routing, aggregation, and record emission.

concepts.title: Feature Overview
concepts.description: Aggregated PM Events reduces the volume of performance management (PM) event data produced by the gNodeB by consolidating high-frequency per-UE and per-procedure events into aggregated event records.

concepts.title: Network Impact
concepts.description: Describes the impact of the Aggregated PM Events feature on the air interface, O&M transport, node processing, and analytics.

concepts.title: Parameters
concepts.description: Configuration parameters controlling PM event aggregation behavior under NodeRoot=1,NrFunction=1,PmEventAggregation=<group>.

concepts.title: Performance Management
concepts.description: Performance management KPIs and counters for monitoring event aggregation volume reduction and data integrity.
